sections.title: Disable or remove stale destinations
sections.excerpt: Disable or remove stale destinations | Before testing, turn off destinations that are no longer needed or use outdated tracking IDs. This keeps validation results clean and avoids polluting old analytics accounts.

sections.title: Review active destinations
sections.excerpt: Review active destinations | This list shows every configured destination and whether it is enabled. Each enabled integration injects automatically into every published web funnel.

sections.title: Enable Segmently Analytics (internal reporting)
sections.excerpt: Enable Segmently Analytics (internal reporting) | Segmently Analytics is the first-party provider behind Segmently Reports and canvas insights. Add and enable it to collect funnel events for reporting and optimization; it is disabled by default.
